name: color-contrast-checker
title: Color Contrast Checker
description: Check WCAG color contrast ratios between two colors picked from screen
author: JADugas

commands.name: index
commands.title: Check Color Contrast
commands.description: Pick two colors from screen and check their WCAG contrast ratio

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
